name: AwanLLM
description: Reliability-first Llama host with a standing free tier and no logging of prompts.
overview: AwanLLM runs Llama models on its own GPUs and offers a standing free tier to developers. Its terms state that prompts and generations are not logged, and the platform publishes no content-based training or improvement use. Rate limits are modest and shared across the free queue.
free_access: Prompts and generations are not logged
Shared free queue with per-key limits
notes: Free capacity is queued behind paying traffic at peak times.
